body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> JVC unveiled 'HA-FXP3', its animal print headphones designed for fashionista during CES 2010, which will be available in four popular animal print patterns: Dalmatian, leopard, zebra stripe and pink zebra stripe.

Designed for fashion-conscious women, they are perfect for accessorizing or simply for standing out in the crowd. A secure, comfortable fit is assured with three different sizes of silicon earpieces supplied: medium, small and extra-small, reflecting the smaller average size of women's ears. Snug-fitting headphones are not only less likely to fall out, they also provide better isolation from outside sounds, and minimize sound leakage.

Rest assured, unlike many of the latest fashions, there's no sacrifice of performance and comfort in the name of style. Each earpiece utilizes a 0.33-inch (8.5 mm) neodymium driver unit that delivers deep, powerful bass and a crisp, detailed high end. The 3.94-foot (1.2 m) friction noise reduction cord and gold-plated iPod/iPhone-compatible plug make the HA-FXP3 a sound choice for people who love to listen to their music on the move.
The JVC HA-FXP3's will be available for $19.95 in February.
